overall: The AG found no violation: the Board met on January 15, 2025, to review the complaint and authorize counsel to respond before the response went to the complainant or the AG, which is what the law requires. The AG also reminded the Board to respond by any extended deadline it grants, noting the Board's response was one day late, but ordered no remedy.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the Board violated the OML by failing to meet to review her December 20, 2024 complaint before delegating authority to respond to it.
allegations.key_passage: we find that the Board did not violate the Open Meeting Law where it met to review the complaint and authorize legal counsel to respond prior to the response being sent to the Complainant or this office.
